text:
- RABBIT NIGHT LIGHT generated £10.7k revenue TW, the highest performing product, with 5,593 units sold and 43 orders.
- ALARM CLOCK BAKELIKE RED achieved £2.4k revenue TW, ranking second among products, followed by CHILLI LIGHTS at £2.3k revenue TW.
- RABBIT NIGHT LIGHT showed the strongest WoW growth at 18,473.8% revenue increase, significantly outperforming other products.
- FLOWERS CHANDELIER T-LIGHT HOLDER demonstrated substantial WoW momentum with a 9,231.2% revenue increase from LW to TW.
- WORLD WAR 2 GLIDERS ASSTD DESIGNS led unit sales TW with 5,328 units, closely behind RABBIT NIGHT LIGHT's 5,593 units.
- CHRISTMAS CRAFT WHITE FAIRY showed exceptional YoY performance with revenue growth of 28,727.6% compared to LY.
- RED HARMONICA IN BOX delivered strong YoY growth of 11,954.9% revenue increase versus LY, indicating significant year-on-year momentum.
- PAPER CHAIN KIT 50'S CHRISTMAS generated the most orders TW with 64 orders, despite ranking fourth in revenue at £2.3k.
